name: pre-read-subagent-attribution
description: SB-25 R2 attribution: a subagent's commit is credited to the SUBAGENT id, not the parent session. Preflight: the parent reads (SHARED), then subagent A edits + commits v2 under the composite identity — invalidating the parent. The parent's re-read is stale and summary.last_writer_session_id MUST be the subagent id (the [:8] short form in prose then names the actual writer). The prose is byte-asserted too (the harness scrubs the two ISO timestamps), which pins the short form actually reaching the model; only the raw timestamps are ignored.
